tasks.title: Finish the API endpoints for notifications and push the code to the repository
Design the notification component and integrate it with the backend API
Connect the email service to our staging environment
Test both the dashboard notifications and email alerts
Prepare the API documentation and upload it to the project repository

transcripts.content:
Priya: Good morning everyone. Today we need to discuss progress on the notification system for the TaskFlow platform.

Rohan: I have already started working on the backend service for sending task reminders. I will finish the API endpoints for notifications and push the code to the repository by Thursday.

Priya: That sounds good. Sneha, once Rohan completes the API, please add the notification panel in the dashboard so users can see reminders for their tasks.

Sneha: Sure. I will design the notification component and integrate it with the backend API by Friday.

Karan: I will also configure the email notification service so that users receive reminders for upcoming deadlines.

Priya: Great. Please make sure the email service is connected to our staging environment before the end of the week.

Meera: After the notification feature is ready, I will test both the dashboard notifications and email alerts to make sure everything works properly.

Priya: Perfect. Also, we need documentation for the notification API. Rohan, please prepare the documentation and upload it to the project repository by Friday.

Rohan: Okay, I will add the API documentation along with usage examples.

Priya: Excellent. Let’s try to complete all these tasks before the next sprint review meeting.
